shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin fell below $83,000, triggering over $500 million in leveraged long position liquidations across the crypto market.
Escalating Middle East conflict and rising oil prices (above $100/barrel) fueled a broad risk-off sentiment, moving capital away from digital assets.
Investors reduced crypto exposure ahead of Federal Reserve minutes, as rising US Treasury yields and a strengthening dollar further pressured risk assets.

Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net inflows of nearly $119 million, while Ethereum ETFs experienced over $200 million in outflows. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index shifted towards neutral (around 59-42) following the market pullback.
